Dr. Mohd Waseem is an internationally trained Chiropractor and Sports Rehabilitation Specialist, with advanced expertise in Neuro Kinetics, Chiropractic Care, Acupuncture, and Hijama (Cupping Therapy). With a refined understanding of the skeletal and nervous systems, he focuses on precise diagnosis and holistic, root-cause–based treatment.

Trained internationally in Malaysia, with clinical exposure aligned to London and European standards, Dr. Waseem has been practicing in Delhi since 2015. He has served as Physiotherapist for the Nepal Cricket Team (2011–2014) and as Physiotherapist on Duty at the ITF Tennis Tournament.

He is the Founder of ROOTs – Holistic Healing, delivering precision-driven, evidence-based, and elite-level care.

Contact: +91 8700748563
ROOTs – Aligning Lives, Naturally.
